Hi all,

YJM Games just launched a brand new VR game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/769640/Lordian_Karma/?beta=0]Lordian: Karma[/url].
It is a action defense VR games that can be played solo or with your friends in multiplayer mode.

To celebrate the launch, YJM Games holds a custom discount for other VR games including Smashing the Battle VR!

Check out all the games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=YJM%20GAMES]here[/url]!

notes.title: [Notice] Vive Controllers Bugs (FIXED)
notes.notes:
[b]UPDATE:

Bug fixed! The RB button(gamepad) issue has been fixed. Now, you can use your 'trigger' button on Vive controllers as the RB button!

Thank you! :D[/b]


Hello everyone,

We want to let you know that at some points during the game, Vive controllers might not work properly. We are going to fix this issue and let you know again as soon as possible. Meanwhile, to maximize the gameplay, we recommend you to play the game using a compatible gamepad for PC until we fix the issues on Vive controllers.

We apologize for this inconvenience and hope you understand :(

Thank you.

notes.title: [MUST READ] The Game Supports Only HTC VIVE!
notes.notes:
Dear everyone,

On the store description, it is stated that the game can be played on HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, and OSVR.
We would like to to let you know that the game only supports [b]HTC VIVE[/b]. 

There is an error on the displaying supported HMD and we are trying to fix it asap to avoid any confusion.

Thank you!

notes.title: Smashing the Battle VR is Out Now for HTC VIVE!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the release of Smashing the Battle VR today! Get 33% off by purchasing the game right now and start the adventure!

For those who does not have VIVE controllers - don't worry! You can play the game using a gamepad! Smashing the Battle VR is a hack n' slash VR game that will take you to the year of 2085 where a hacking incident happens. Choose one heroine and follow her story to the end!

We hope you enjoy the game and feel free to reach us at smashing@yjmgames.com for inquiries! 

Cheers! ːsteamhappyː
